label: Radical Expressions
subgoals: A polynomial is solvable by radicals when its roots can be built from the coefficients using field operations and root extraction.
Galois theory turns this into a property of the Galois group.

label: The Quintic
subgoals: The general polynomial of degree n has Galois group the symmetric group on n symbols.
The symmetric group is solvable up to degree four and not solvable from degree five.

label: Degree Is Not the Whole Story
section: Degree Is Not the Whole Story
subgoals: Special polynomials of high degree can still be solvable.
The criterion depends on the particular Galois group.
